parameters.content:
## YouTube Caption & Whisper AI Transcript Extractor

**Actor:** [YouTube Caption & Whisper AI Transcript Extractor](https://apify.com/nimbryxo-studio/youtube-caption-and-whisper-ai-transcript)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/youtube-caption-and-whisper-ai-transcript-extractor.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string)
- `videoUrls` (array)
- `channelUrls` (array)
- `maxVideosPerChannel` (integer)
- `playlistUrls` (array)
- `maxVideosPerPlaylist` (integer)
- `language` (string)
- `includeAutoGenerated` (boolean)
- `useWhisper` (boolean)
- `whisperModel` (string)
- `includeWordTimings` (boolean)
- `maxWhisperMinutes` (integer)

### Output fields
- `video_id` (Video id)
- `title` (Title)
- `channel_name` (Channel name)
- `publishedAt` (Published At)
- `transcript_language` (Transcript language)
- `segment_count` (Segment count)
- `success` (Success)
- `transcript_available` (Transcript available)
- `transcript_source` (Transcript source)
- `accessStatus` (Access Status)
- `errorCode` (Error Code)
- `duration_seconds` (Duration seconds)

description: YouTube caption scraper: runs the YouTube Caption & Whisper AI Transcript Extractor Apify Actor, returns video_id, title, channel_name, publishedAt, transcript_language and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
